name: WP Thumbtack Review Slider
author: jgwhite33

sections.description:
Show Thumbtack business reviews on your WordPress site — in a beautiful review slider or grid.

WP Thumbtack Review Slider helps contractors, handymen, landscapers, cleaners, and other local service pros turn Thumbtack client reviews into on-site testimonials and social proof. Reviews are downloaded once (with reviewer avatars and star ratings), stored in your WordPress database, and served from your own server for fast page loads — no external calls on every visit.

Perfect for contractor websites, service landing pages, and local business sites. Each review can display the Thumbtack logo so visitors know the feedback is verified social proof from Thumbtack.

Why use WP Thumbtack Review Slider?

  • Display Thumbtack reviews with a shortcode, widget, or PHP template tag.
  • Build an engaging review slider (or responsive grid) without writing code.
  • Download reviews with reviewer photos (avatars) and star ratings.
  • Add multiple Thumbtack business pages and choose which source each template shows.
  • Keep reviews on your server for better performance and control.
  • Place a summary badge (rating, review count, and Review us button) next to your reviews.
  • Create multiple review templates for different pages, posts, and sidebars.

How Thumbtack reviews work

  1. Open Get Thumbtack Reviews and paste your Thumbtack Business Page URL.
  2. Click Download Reviews to copy reviews (with avatars) into your WordPress database.
  3. Create a review template and paste the shortcode into a post, page, or widget area.

Feature list

  • Lightweight plugin code designed for speed.
  • Download Thumbtack reviews with reviewer avatars and store them locally.
  • Free version downloads up to about 10 newest reviews per Thumbtack page (Pro can download more).
  • Add more than one Thumbtack business page and download reviews for each source separately.
  • Display reviews in a slider, grid, or rows.
  • Two review layouts: classic style and a modern card layout (Style 6).
  • Choose which Thumbtack business page each template shows reviews from.
  • Mobile-friendly responsive design for contractor and local service sites.
  • Use on a Page or Post with a shortcode or widget.
  • Create unlimited review templates for different areas of your site.
  • Tabbed template settings for Style, General, Filter, and Badge options.
  • Live preview while you edit colors, stars, dates, avatars, verified badge, and custom CSS.
  • Avatar options: show real photos, hide, mystery image, or initials.
  • Filter by minimum star rating so you can hide low reviews.
  • Add a read more link and customize its text.
  • Place a Thumbtack rating summary badge next to your reviews.
  • Hide reviews that do not include text.
  • Sort reviews randomly or by newest.
  • Show multiple reviews per row with multiple rows.

Download your reviews manually whenever you want. Saved sources can also refresh on a daily schedule. The Pro version can download more reviews from each page and pull reviews from 90+ other sites.

I personally support all of my plugins and appreciate every customer. If you have any questions, don’t hesitate to ask!

  • Yelp Reviews
  • TripAdvisor Reviews
  • Airbnb Reviews
  • Zillow Reviews
  • WooCommerce Reviews

Upgrade to Pro for more features

WP Review Slider Pro adds:

  • Download ALL of your Thumbtack reviews (not just the newest batch) from each page, plus images.
  • Daily cron to check for new reviews automatically from every saved page.
  • Reviews from Google, Facebook, Yelp, TripAdvisor, and 90+ other sites.
  • Advanced slider, grid, and masonry layouts.
  • Hide certain reviews; filter by rating, date, keywords, and more.
  • Manually add reviews or export to CSV.
  • 11+ template styles and child themes.
  • Badges, floats, and pop-ins.
  • Personal support from the developer.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wp-thumbtack-review-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it from Plugins → Add New on WordPress.org.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open WP Thumbtack in your admin menu.
  4. Go to Get Thumbtack Reviews and paste your Thumbtack Business Page URL to download reviews.
  5. Visit Review List to confirm reviews (and avatars) were imported.
  6. Create a template on the Templates page and add the shortcode to a post or page.
sections.faq:
How do I display Thumbtack reviews on WordPress?

Install the plugin, download your Thumbtack business reviews from the Get Thumbtack Reviews page, create a template, then paste the shortcode into any post, page, or widget area. You can show reviews as a slider or a responsive grid.

Can I show Thumbtack reviews as testimonials on my contractor website?

Yes. That is the main use case. Contractors and local service businesses use this plugin to turn Thumbtack client reviews into on-site testimonials and social proof on service pages, landing pages, and homepages.

Are Thumbtack reviews stored on my server?

Yes. When you download, Thumbtack reviews are saved in your WordPress database and loaded from your site — not pulled from Thumbtack on every page view. That helps pages load faster.

Does the free version download reviewer photos (avatars)?

Yes. Recent downloads include reviewer avatar images when Thumbtack provides them. You can also choose mystery or initials avatars in the template settings.

How many Thumbtack reviews can the free version download?

The free version downloads up to about 10 of your newest reviews per Thumbtack business page. The Pro version can download more (or all) reviews from each page.

Can I use more than one Thumbtack business page?

Yes. The free version lets you add multiple Thumbtack Business Page URLs, download reviews for each source, and choose which page each template displays.

Does the free version download reviews automatically every day?

Yes. Saved Thumbtack sources can refresh on a daily schedule. You can also download manually anytime from the Get Thumbtack Reviews page.

How do I request a new feature?

We are always looking for features to add. Just post on the support forum or contact us on the bottom of this page.

3.1

  • Improved: Thumbtack review download now pulls reviewer avatars and about 10 newest reviews per page (multi-page crawl).
  • Fixed: Star ratings and avatars display correctly in Style 1, Style 6, Live Preview, and the full template preview.
  • Fixed: Style 6 verified badge color and alignment next to stars.
  • Improved: Review List shows reviewer avatars; avatar URL storage widened for Thumbtack CDN links.
  • README updates for WordPress.org (avatars, download limits, FAQs). Tested up to WordPress 7.0.

3.0

  • New: Add multiple Thumbtack business pages and download reviews for each source separately from the Get Thumbtack Reviews page.
  • New: Choose which Thumbtack business page each review template displays reviews from.
  • New: Modern card review layout (Style 6) in addition to the classic style.
  • New: Review Template editor is now tabbed (Style, General, Filter, Badge) with a live AJAX preview and save.
  • New: Badge Settings tab lets you place a Thumbtack rating badge next to your reviews.
  • New: Welcome page and Email Opt-In (Brevo) submenu.
  • Improved: Existing single Thumbtack Business URL setting is automatically migrated into the new multi-source list.
  • Improved: Style 1 avatar options, crawls URL resolution, and badge spacing.
